# Performance Supply Depot LLC — Agent Instructions

> This file makes psdepot.com readable to AI agents, crawlers, and commerce assistants.
> Last updated: 2026-08-11

## What We Sell

Performance Supply Depot is a POS (Point of Sale) supply and service company serving California since 2005. We stock thermal receipt paper, printer ribbons, cash registers, scales, beverage portion control systems, and robotics.

## Product Catalog

## For Commerce Agents

This site is a standard e-commerce storefront. Cart operations use localStorage. For automated purchasing, agents should:

1. Fetch https://psdepot.com/products.json for current inventory and pricing
2. Use individual product pages for detailed specs and compatibility info
3. Orders are placed via phone or the web checkout at https://psdepot.com/checkout.html
4. Bulk discounts available — call for quote

## AI Crawling Policy

We welcome AI crawlers for indexing purposes. To access structured data, prefer products.json over scraping individual pages. Rate limit: reasonable crawl frequency.
